overview: The Medford City Council held its regular meeting to act on infrastructure loan orders, local resolutions, and ordinance final readings. Key actions included approving loan orders for sidewalk repairs and tree stump removal, requesting a site visit from DCR leadership, and passing ordinances prohibiting polystyrene and regulating snow removal.

items.title: Law Department Claim Reimbursement
items.summary: Approved a $2,850 settlement expenditure to reimburse city clerk Adam Hurtubise for sewer damage to his property.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records for the City Council meetings held on May 3, 2022, and May 10, 2022.

items.title: Committee Report on Affordable Housing Trust
items.summary: Approved the Committee of the Whole report concerning the Affordable Housing Trust.

items.title: Haitian Heritage Month and Haitian Flag Day
items.summary: Approved joined resolutions recognizing and celebrating Haitian Heritage Month and Haitian Flag Day.

items.title: DCR Site Visit and Maintenance Agreement Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting DCR Commissioner Stephanie Cooper for a site visit in Medford and requesting copies of state maintenance agreements.

items.title: National Grid Utility Pole Relocation
items.summary: Approved a petition from National Grid to relocate a utility pole on Medford Street following a presentation by a company representative.

items.title: FY23 City Budget Council Proposals
items.summary: Passed a resolution asking council members to submit FY23 budget proposals to the city clerk by May 23 ahead of committee review meetings.

items.title: Riverside Avenue Bocce Court Repairs
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the contractor to repair the Riverside Avenue bocce courts to proper standards or face legal action.

items.title: Loan Orders for Sidewalk Repairs and Stump Removal
items.summary: Approved third readings for loan orders for sidewalk repairs and tree stump removal following a data-driven presentation by Department of Public Works officials.

items.title: Polystyrene Prohibition and Snow Removal Ordinances
items.summary: Passed third readings approving ordinances prohibiting polystyrene food packaging and updating snow and ice removal regulations.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident spoke during public participation to acknowledge Police Appreciation Week and express disappointment regarding previous council remarks about the police department.
